answers.introduction: I am a junior developer with experience on a small Python utility and a course RAG project. I am interested in developing stronger production engineering skills.
answers.candidate_background: I have about one year of junior development experience. Most of my work involved a Python API, SQL queries, basic tests, and communicating progress to my team.
answers.cv_project_validation: I built the Orchid internal Python API with SQL and added a few pytest checks. It was used by a small team, but I did not own deployment or define production monitoring.
answers.technical: I used a RAG starter project in a course and connected it to a vector database. I understand that retrieval selects context before generation, although I have not designed a formal evaluation set.
answers.problem_solving: A SQL query was slow, so I reviewed the logs with a senior engineer and added an index. I checked the result manually, but we did not record a detailed benchmark.
answers.behavioral: I explained a delayed task to a teammate, shared what was blocking me, and asked for help. We adjusted the work and I provided progress updates during the next meeting.
answers.closing: I would like to learn more about the team's onboarding process and the kinds of RAG projects a junior engineer supports.
answers.follow_up: My direct experience is limited to the small Python API and course RAG exercise. I can describe the basic implementation, but I have not yet validated it in a production environment.
answers.fallback: My experience is introductory, so I can explain the small implementation I completed and identify the production details I would need to learn.
